basic_info.description: Amazing newly built Penthouse, 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence in the newly completed 350 San Jose, a collection of 13 contemporary residences on a quiet block of San Jose Avenue. Condominium boasts an amazing floor plan with a large island kitchen including a fully integrated, cabinet-faced refrigerator, wine chiller, dishwasher, quartz countertops and under cabinet lighting. The two luxurious bathrooms are fit for a spa with designer tile finishes, quartz vanity tops, dual under-mounted sinks, widespread faucets and walk-in shower with glass partition and hand-shower.  Other features include underfloor heating and Huge west facing deck overlooking quaint Juri Commons and the San Francisco hill side.
